name: Design and draft survey questionnaires
description: Users asked to design, draft, or refine survey questionnaires and question sets for various academic, business, and personal research contexts. These tasks included specifying question types like Likert scales or multiple-choice, defining target audiences, and addressing specific topics such as student satisfaction, employee feedback, product perception, and psychological assessments.
